notes: DCA obligations: present_need=62, prospective_need=223. Total 4th Round obligation per HEFSP = 395 units (Prior Round Unmet Need 47 + Prospective Unmet Need 337 + RDP 11). Round 3 VLA originally yielded 0 RDP; changed circumstances (V&R Developers acquiring land) created 11-unit RDP from 2 sites. RDP comprises 3 units from Block 401 Lots 1&2 + 5 units from Block 2801 Lot 1 (total stated as 11 but text shows 3+5=8 for RDP; likely 3+8=11 with bonus credits). TOD-1 overlay is the primary unmet need mechanism (19.269 ac, 25 du/ac, 20% set-aside, 96 affordable units capacity). Block 503 Lot 1 overlay ELIMINATED in 2024 Master Plan Reexamination. Developer agreement with V&R Developers in place for both RDP sites. Candidate snapshot had only Block 401 Lots 1&2 (1 site) and no obligations set — corrected to 2 sites and obligations stated.

sites.site_name: Block 401 Lots 1 & 2 — V&R Developers Inclusionary (Group Home + MF)
sites.quote: Block 401, Lots 1 & 2 had been acquired by V&R Developers. A total of 23 units are proposed for this site, plus one group home. ... The total number of affordable units on this site is 4 group home bedrooms + 2 supportive housing + 1 family unit = 7 affordable housing units. Three (3) of the affordable housing units are allocated to meet the total RDP for both this site and Block 2801, Lot 1.
sites.notes: 0.822 total acres; 0.666 usable acres for 21-unit MF portion + 0.156 acres for group home subdivision. 23 MF units + 1 group home = 24 total. 7 affordable: 4 group home bedrooms (Bergen County United Way) + 2 supportive housing + 1 family unit. 3 of the 7 count toward combined RDP with Block 2801. Developer agreement in place as of 2025. $153,071.10 affordable housing trust fund pledged to NJ Housing and Finance Agency for group home.

sites.site_name: Block 2801 Lot 1 — Former Borough Municipal Building (V&R Developers)
sites.address: Grand Avenue / Hillside Street (former Borough Municipal Building)
sites.quote: Block 2801, Lot 1 is a .7-acre site that contains the former Borough Municipal Building. This site will be sold to V&R Developers for construction of a market-rate and affordable housing development. A total of 32 units are proposed, including three (3) family affordable units, two (2) supportive affordable housing units, and twenty-seven (27) market rate units. This site will provide 5 units of affordable housing to meet the total RDP for both this site and Block 401, Lots 1 &2.
sites.notes: 0.7 acres; 32 total units (27 market + 3 family affordable + 2 supportive affordable). 5 affordable units toward combined RDP for both sites. Borough selling property to V&R Developers. Site previously rezoned as part of Redevelopment Plan, modified to reflect described development. Developer agreement in place as of 2025. Not in candidate snapshot — new site identified in HEFSP.

sites.quote: The TOD 1 overlay zone consists of 19.269 total acres. The TOD-1 zone is proposed for multifamily residential with a mandatory 20% affordable housing set-aside at a density of 25 du/ac. The TOD-1 zone can produce a total of 96 affordable units. 2025 update: No units have been built in the TOD-1 zone to date.
sites.notes: Unmet Need mechanism. 19.269 acres total; 25 du/ac density; 20% mandatory set-aside; capacity of 96 affordable units. No individual block/lot specified in HEFSP. Established in 2024 Master Plan Reexamination replacing prior R-TH/R-SR zones. No units built to date.
